errors.evidence: The description states there are eight categories on the horizontal axis, but there are nine distinct groups of bars shown in the chart (GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard).
The label on the x-axis is "MBPP", not "MBPp".
The label on the x-axis is "LC AlpacaEval-2", not "LC_AlpacaEval-2".
The categories on the x-axis are not in alphabetical order. For example, 'GSM-8K' is followed by 'MMLU'.

errors.text_span: The blue bars range in height from approximately 52% for Chat-Arena-Hard to roughly 77% for GSM-8K
errors.evidence: The stated range for the blue bars is incorrect. The lowest value for a blue bar is for 'Chat-Arena-Hard' at approximately 21% (not 52%), and the highest is for 'GSM-8K' at approximately 79% (not 77%).
